method: Computed the SHA256 of every final original PNG and compared it with its exact hash recorded in the completed first visual review. Reused that review only for 109 byte-identical images.
Opened all 15 final contact-sheet PNGs that contain changed screenshots through view_image. Actually inspected every one of the 47 changed model screenshots.
Opened all four theory6 original PNGs at original resolution to inspect the changed caption in initial/last states at 320/1280 viewport widths.

Checked distinct and unclipped point labels, readable angle/equality markers, correct initial/final geometric relationships and model clutter. The newly written caption was fully checked in the originals; some contact-sheet tiles crop captions.
Programmatically verified the complete 39 × 2 × 2 image matrix and membership in the final browser evidence screenshot list.

firstReviewUsedForIdenticalImages.note: The first browser run later failed a separate course-conflict interaction. Its complete screenshot visual review is reused only where the final PNG is byte-identical; final automation is independently recorded as completed.

findings.subject: all 156 final model screenshots
findings.result: No overlapping or clipped point labels, incorrect final geometric relationships, or congested model interiors were found in the reviewed images.

findings.subject: theory6 caption, all four final original PNGs
findings.result: The caption correctly names the separate views for segment/angle comparison, a segment midpoint and an angle bisector. Its text is complete and readable at both widths, without clipping.

findings.subject: theory9 320 px model
findings.result: The left-hand label B is now farther from the model boundary and remains fully visible.

findings.subject: selfcheck12 initial 320 px model
findings.result: This image is byte-identical to the previously checked original. A and P remain close but distinct and readable.

findings.subject: angle and equality markers in changed PNGs
findings.result: Ordinary angle arcs and equality tick marks remain legible and separate from point labels.

limitations: This report certifies initial and last model screenshots only; it does not newly certify every intermediate state or alternative case visually.
Full-page layout, dynamic controls, fullscreen behavior, persistence and concurrent-session behavior are outside this image-only review; the completed browser automation is separate evidence.
This verdict applies to the exact final PNG hashes listed. Later changed images require renewed visual inspection.
The browser version was reported by the capture operator; it is not independently established by these screenshots or the evidence JSON.
